description.name: DNA SSL Certificates
description.tagline: Sell Domain Name API SSL certificates with automated ordering, validation and delivery.
description.long: Sells the DV, OV, EV, wildcard and multi-domain SSL certificates of your Domain Name API reseller account. Orders open automatically on activation; clients submit or generate their CSR, pick e-mail, HTTP or DNS validation, follow the validation instructions and download the issued certificate from the client area.
features: Automatic order on activation, renewal as a new order
CSR paste or generation, with private key download
E-mail, HTTP file and DNS (CNAME) domain validation
Certificate download and reissue from the client area
